title: The CloudEvents key and actor attributes, the idempotency-key format, the relay publish limit and the registry subject of the case topic are not in the sources
source: RWB-E1-067 sections 3, 4, 12 and 13 (the outbox header carries event ID, idempotency key, schema version, occurred time and actor; retry limit 3; key example EV-02-RW-2026-000301-20261201); Architecture v5 slide 11 (CloudEvents 1.0 in binary mode, BACKWARD schema registry) and slide 44 (JOB-11 Outbox sender); TSD P3 v3 T5.3 (the seven case events) and T-A.1 API-P3-006
description: The legacy story fixes what the outbox header must carry but names no CloudEvents attribute for it, gives one idempotency-key example for CaseAllocated and no format rule per event, states the consumer retry limit of 3 with no publish limit for the relay, and never names the registry subject of a topic. This story needs those four values on the rwb-case side: which extension attributes carry the idempotency key and the actor, what the key of each of the four events looks like, what the relay does when its own publish attempt fails, and under which subject the JSON Schema of the case topic is registered. The values are chosen once, recorded, and read as configuration; the story states them so they can be reviewed before the listener is live.
evidence: RWB-E1-067 section 3: 'the outbox delivers events at least once ... with event ID, idempotency key, schema version, occurred time and actor in the event header, and moves an event to the exception queue after the retry limit'; section 7 AC3: 'idempotency key "EV-02-RW-2026-000301-20261201"'; section 13: 'retry limit 3 from the outbox settings (NFR-026; DL11)'. Architecture v5 slide 11: 'CloudEvents 1.0 in binary mode, key caseId, JSON Schema registry with BACKWARD compatibility'. No source names ce_idempotencykey, ce_actor, a per-event key format, a relay publish limit or a registry subject.
owner_role: rwb-case contract owner and the platform event library owner
proposed: Adopt ce_idempotencykey and ce_actor as the two extension attributes, keep the key shape of the legacy example (event code, case number, action date) for the four events, read the relay publish limit as a platform parameter with no value written in code, and register the four types under the subject the platform naming library derives from rwb.case.events.v1; record the four values in the API and event specification of rwb-case and re-test the envelopes at the contract level.
